title: WorldVersionBackport
description: A minecraft fabric mod that allows older minecraft versions (pre 26.2) to load newer worlds that have been '''''''''upgraded''''''' and deupgrade them
body:
![before my mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24a8b5bac9ec4eb2b7b9a103bbae969a65e1d360.png) ![if you have my very cool mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf89e73a0f66b38b30e1bd86db832de01239a16b.png) **THIS MOD IS IN ALPHA, I AM NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR CARELESSNESS, MAKE BACKUPS OF ANY WORLD YOU LOAD USING THIS MOD, CURRENTLY, IT DOES NOT FIX SERVERS** ![github](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/196dc5e02b113d73ff19efefd75d89c0341f1a5d.png) https://github.com/DefaultUser9148/worldversionbackport
![modrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cbdf57b0a85e21644b582f065ba2fb06d639ccf.png) https://modrinth.com/mod/worldversionbackport ![fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/434411d3bef6b02f70fadc518af5bd2d2693c0d3.png) https://fabricmc.net/ !!! **Make backups of any world before loading with this mod. Not responsible for data loss. Currently incompatible with servers.** *Why use new world folder when old one do trick?* A minecraft fabric mod to allow anyone playing older versions of minecraft (pre 26.2 which dont have Vulkan option) to load and play newer worlds which feature the Vulkan renderer in the video options. And also allows to deupgrade worlds, so you can then remove this mod Optional: ModMenu **First made for 1.21.4, this version will get the most attention from me.** | MC Version | Support Status | Priority | Tested up to | End Of Life Status | |-----------|----------|---------|--------------|-----------| | 1.21.11 | Coming Soon | High | - || | 1.21.5-1.21.10 | Supported | High | - || | 1.21.4 | Supported | Main Mod Version | 26.2-prerelease-2 || | 1.21.3-1.21 | Coming Soon | Low | - || ### Why? Minecraft 26.2-snapshot-1 and i think any version after 26.2 (Which introduced the Vulkan renderer) made several changes to any world that was generated in a previous version because the world generation thing is hardcoded or something, but this 'Upgrading' that happens for older worlds almost COMPLETELY making ANY OTHER VERSION unable to load the world correctly or find any of the chunks/player files as it changes a lot of stuff, most notably the regions and playerdata, moving them into subfolders and making any old version regenerate all of the chunks in the root, and unable to find the playerdata. ### Incompatibilities | Mod | Issue | Last Checked | |-----|-------|---------------| | Rocks and Pebbles | Crashes when loading a 26.2 world due to new version-specific data | 9th April 2026 | ---
